verdict.rationale: Paperspace publishes an official API reference, generated from its OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, with per-endpoint cURL examples that a user can copy and run. However, the reference is explicitly static with no in-page runner, so the 'interactive' part of the story is not delivered. Importing the OpenAPI spec into a third-party tool would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: an interactive in-page request runner or try-it console, examples executable directly in the docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: a static generated per-endpoint reference with copyable cURL examples
The DigitalOcean-hosted Paperspace API reference is generated from it.
